title: The Dimension of Infinite Consciousness
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 28.6 Linked Discourses 28.6
  • 1. Sāriputtavagga 1. With Sāriputta

Viññāṇañcāyatanasutta The Dimension of Infinite Consciousness

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

Addasā kho āyasmā ānando …pe… Venerable Ānanda saw Venerable Sāriputta …

“idhāhaṁ, āvuso, sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṁ samatikkamma anantaṁ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṁ upasampajja viharāmi …pe… “Reverend, going totally beyond the dimension of infinite space, aware that ‘consciousness is infinite’, I entered and remained in the dimension of infinite consciousness. …” … vuṭṭhitoti vā”ti.

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
